title: Eric Ries on TikTok: 'if either the CEO or the CFO have stock options vesting in that quarter, then on average R&D spending will be lower'
summary: Eric answers a viewer who argued that quarterly reporting is how executives get paid, with the finding on options vesting and research spending. The clip has 4,268 plays, the most of any he has posted since June.
blockquote:
In a given quarter, if either the CEO or the CFO have stock options vesting in that quarter, then on average R&D spending will be lower by that company.
Think about what that means. The incentives we give executives can influence whether a company invests in its future or prioritizes short-term financial rewards.
